author: steven5703
body:
Map of CratesEDM: http://ragingbuilds.github.io/server/index
Zoom out and look for the green looking boxes :> (might take time for your browser to render)



Images: http://imgur.com/a/R7anh
Download: Sorry no, just log onto my server if you have the IP or ask me on skype @ stevenr5703
YML: Not finished.


Keep in mind that you cannon bridge to the other side! Only shoot cannons to destroy the monuments or kill players!
Main island can not be destroyed.
NOTE: This map is for a gamemode I suggested. However, I can switch this over to TDM if needed. If this is changed to TDM I will allow bridging for nonstop pvp like Nexus.
